mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate directly increases the discount rate applied to equity valuations, reducing the present value of future cash flows and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is greater than -0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals labor market deterioration and economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (MoM < 0) over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth below 0.5% annually signals supply-side constraints and impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth is below 0.5% annually over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 4.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 4.0% over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly nonfarm payroll increase exceeding 100k signals robust labor market strength and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases above 100k over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly GDP growth below 1.0% and housing starts decline indicate economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is below 1.0% and HOUST declines (MoM < 0) over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 4.0%), a federal funds rate above 5.0% signals aggressive tightening, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS > 5.0% over the last 5 years.
